boilerplate: SNYPD is a Vinted monitor from Belgium that checks your Vinted searches about every 30 seconds to a minute and sends a push alert when a new matching listing appears; it never logs in to your Vinted account and never buys for you.
note: Every claim is on outreach/00-fact-sheet.md: about every 30 seconds to a minute = measured median 30 s, 78% of checks within 60 s (check-interval.json, re-measured 20 Nov 2026); push alerts; never logs in; no autobuy. gen_regions.py writes it into the Organization JSON-LD of index.html.
